description: Invent is a customer communication platform for businesses to run AI assistants across messaging channels, shared inboxes, contacts, broadcasts, knowledge, workflows, and related workspace features. It lets organizations manage conversations, channels, campaigns, and operational data from one system.
summary: useinvent.com exposes an authenticated REST API at `https://api.useinvent.com` and an MCP server at `https://api.useinvent.com/mcp`; the REST API uses Invent API keys, while MCP supports OAuth sign-in and also documents API-key access.
